retrievalProfile.description: A melancholic 1950s urban park portrait featuring a seated figure in red plaid against a lush green background with a stone bridge and mixed script-sans typography.
triggerTerms: seated portrait on park bench with stone bridge background
red script title with white outline
excludeWhen: modern high-definition digital photography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A pensive portrait of a woman seated on a concrete park bench, wearing a red and black plaid wrap. The background features a soft-focus stone arch bridge over water, surrounded by dense green foliage and a hazy city skyline. The composition is characterized by a heavy film grain, high-contrast shadows, and a saturated color palette dominated by deep greens and vibrant reds.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in red plaid creates a focal point against the deep green environment
Curved park bench in the foreground mirrors the arch of the bridge in the mid-ground
Text is distributed across the upper and right quadrants to balance the subject on the left
Atmospheric haze in the background provides depth and separation from the sharp foreground bench
coreInvariants: Deep teal-green color cast in shadows
Concrete park bench with curved armrest

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated in the lower-left quadrant, occupying approximately one-third of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red script title in the top-left and the subject's red garment provide the primary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red title, moves down to the subject's face, follows the line of the bench toward the bridge, and ends at the tracklist on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper-right and center-right, filled with soft-focus foliage and water.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest green and teal (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant scarlet red (garment and title text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm tan and beige (bench and stone bridge)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and greens with crushed blacks and a slightly yellowed highlights typical of aged film.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or synthetic modern colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of casual brush script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a fluid, upright brush script with a thick white outline
Secondary text uses a wide, all-caps geometric sans-serif
Tracklist uses a slanted, informal cursive script
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title letters are tightly kerned with overlapping strokes
Sans-serif text is widely tracked for an 'exclusive' feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of organic script with rigid geometric sans-serif to evoke mid-century commercial design.
graphicDevices: Bottom-left technical metadata box with logo and catalog number

preserve: White outline on the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century casual brush feel
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1950s style color photograph of a woman in a red plaid wrap sitting on a concrete park bench. The background should be a soft-focus park with a stone arch bridge and green trees. Apply heavy film grain and a technicolor teal-green tint to the shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large red brush script title with a white outline in the top-left. Add a two-line red geometric sans-serif subtitle in the top-right with wide tracking. Add a tracklist in white informal script down the right side.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Does the red text pop against the green background?
Is the bench's curved armrest prominent in the foreground?
Is the bridge correctly blurred to create depth?

adjustableVariables: Blur depth of the background bridge
Tracking width of the sans-serif text
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the white outline on the main title
Verify the subject is wearing red plaid
Ensure the background bridge is a stone arch
Confirm the overall color cast is slightly teal/green
Check that the text is not overlapping the subject's face
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in [Primary Color] [Pattern] garment + [Environment] with [Architectural Element] + [Script Title with Outline] + [Geometric Sans Subtitle]
